name: DateTimeInput
description:
A date and a time in one box: a day typed in the locale's order and a time typed as people
write it, with one button that opens a calendar beside a list of times (stacked when
narrow). The value is a wall clock with no offset; with `timeZone` the zone shows in the box.
Each part is one tab stop; the time part steps with the arrow keys like TimeInput.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onReject, timeZone, locale, hourCycle, min, max, step, suggestions, defaultTime, size, width, disabled, readOnly, invalid, required, name, id, onBlur, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy, dateLabel, timeLabel, ref, }: DateTimeInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the group when no Field label names it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: Accessible names of the two parts (default "Date", "Time").

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time filled in when a day is entered or picked before any time ("09:00").

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial date and time when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Override the locale's clock: 12 (am/pm) or 24.

props.name: id
props.description: The date input's id; a Field label points at it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field. Text that cannot be read marks the field invalid by itself.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the date order, the clock and names (default en-AU).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed wall-clock date and time.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed wall-clock date and time.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of the date input (the time input takes `name` + "-time").

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the field, after the typed value has been committed.

props.name: onReject
props.description:
Called instead of `onValueChange` when the field is left incomplete, unreadable or outside
min/max: with the wall-clock value when both parts read (so a schema can name the range),
else with `date` + "T" + `time`, each part as read or as typed. The box is marked invalid.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with a complete date and time, or null when both parts are emptied. Typing commits
when focus leaves the field or on Enter; the calendar, the list and arrow keys commit at once.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the date input, for focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks both parts required for assistive technology; pair it with `dateTimeSchema({ required: true })`.

props.name: size
props.description: The box height, matching DateField.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between suggested times, and between arrow-key steps on the minutes (default 15).

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Explicit times to offer in the list instead of every `step` minutes.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the time part (default "Time").

props.name: timeZone
props.description:
IANA zone the wall clock is read in ("Australia/Sydney"). Shown in the box as its
abbreviation or offset on that date; the list leaves out times a daylight-saving change
skips. The value never converts: use `resolveWallClock` for the instant.

props.name: value
props.description: A wall-clock date and time (`2026-10-21T09:30`) with no offset, or null when empty.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). Default medium.
